name: pawborough-yuyuan-area-authoring
description: 全域底模批：豫园内部 + 城隍庙组团 + 小吃商业街。单一 layout.json 派生 3D/2D/分区清单。

scripts.build: npm run layout && npm run scene && npm run assemble && npm run validate
scripts.test: node tests/geo-tests.mjs && OUT_DIR=${OUT_DIR:-out} node tests/check-export.mjs && OUT_DIR=${OUT_DIR:-out} node tests/coverage-negative-test.mjs && node tests/passage-repair-test.mjs && OUT_DIR=${OUT_DIR:-out-zone} node tests/sansuitang-test.mjs
scripts.verify: npm test && node scripts/validate.mjs && node scripts/check-food.mjs
